stage0008_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$カイザス$$
「...It seems the unit that descended to Earth
　safely accomplished its objective.」

stage0008_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ギュネイ・ガス$$...
　He's more useful than I expected.」

stage0008_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Well, this should make the Earth Federation's
　intentions clear now, wouldn't you say...」

stage0008_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I wonder.
　...Can we really afford to keep taking
　such half-measures?」

stage0008_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カイザス$$
「But this is that man's, the Colonel's, wish.」

stage0008_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カイザス$$
「His existence could become a figurehead for Neo Zeon.」

stage0008_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Which one the times call for,
　Your Excellency surely already knows.」

stage0008_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「He'd suit the role of go-between, at least...」

stage0008_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カイザス$$
「This too, though it's been half a year now,
　stems from him vanishing from $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

stage0008_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カイザス$$
「For my part, I hope that he will make up his mind.」

stage0008_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... We're both lingering on him.」

stage0008_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カイザス$$
「It's not just you and I, Your Excellency.
　To every Spacenoid,
　his existence is something special.」

stage0008_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カイザス$$
「That's why the Colonel is needed for the age to come.」

stage0008_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I understand that as well.
　That's why I take the front and handle the drudgery.」

stage0008_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$カイザス$$
「I sympathize with your burden.」

stage0008_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「All that's left is to wait on the Federation's move.
　Depending how it goes, we may get busy.」

stage0008_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Then I'll begin preparing for talks with $$プラント$$.」

stage0008_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（$$シャア$$...
　The world turns on, even without you...）

stage0008_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（In this world, I'll fulfill Zeon's cherished wish.
　By my own hand...）

stage0008_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$甲児$$
「...I get the Londo Bell mission, but
　isn't Neo Zeon a political group that argues
　for expanding colony rights?」

stage0008_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$甲児$$
「Right now Earth and the colonies are united
　under one Earth Federation, so isn't Neo Zeon's
　military just part of the Earth Federation Forces?」

stage0008_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Officially, that's how it stands.」

stage0008_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You and $$アルト$$ are from 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》, $$甲児$$,
　so you probably don't really know
　what Zeon even is...」

stage0008_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Where I'm from, in 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》,
　that name carries a special meaning.」

stage0008_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「About ten years ago, Zeon was one of the
　worlds making up 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》, and it started
　a war of independence from the Earth Federation.」

stage0008_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ever since, that name has stood for
　the grievances and anger of Spacenoids...
　people who live in space.」

stage0008_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アルト$$
「But Zeon lost to the Earth Federation, right?」

stage0008_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's right.
　But part of their forces escaped the Earth Sphere
　and waited for a chance to rise again.」

stage0008_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「And plenty of people were also unhappy with
　the Federation's later Spacenoid policies.」

stage0008_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So Zeon's influence never really faded,
　and that held true even after the $$大時空震動$$.」

stage0008_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ファ$$
「Even in the 《$$多元戦争$$》 that happened in
　《$$ＵＣＷ$$》, the Zeon remnant 《$$アクシズ$$》 allied with
　《$$プラント$$》 and fought the Earth Federation.」

stage0008_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「After that fight, while we were flung to $$ＡＤＷ$$...
　Zeon renamed itself Neo Zeon back in $$ＵＣＷ$$
　and came back into the open.」

stage0008_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$さやか$$
「But the $$新世時空震動$$ merged $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$,
　and Neo Zeon and $$プラント$$ joined the Earth
　Federation like the other colony nations.」

stage0008_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Not a few people see that as only temporary.」

stage0008_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「In fact, even in this new world,
　some Spacenoids are already growing unhappy
　with the Federation's policies.」

stage0008_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「True.
　In the Federal Assembly too, Neo Zeon and
　$$プラント$$ act as the opposition.」

stage0008_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Neo Zeon's representative is that
　woman, $$ハマーン・カーン$$, right?」

stage0008_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I've seen her on TV too.
　Quite the beauty, but she looks tough.」

stage0008_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ミシェル$$'s right, she's a strong person.
　As a pilot, and as a political leader too...」

stage0008_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「And it's also true that the Earth Federation
　today tends to look down on Spacenoids.」

stage0008_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Against that faction,
　$$ハマーン$$ will never back down.」

stage0008_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アルト$$
「Still, 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》 also had a tendency
　to look down on Spacenoids, but I didn't
　know 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》 was the same...」

stage0008_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Inside $$ＵＣＷ$$'s Earth Federation,
　groups like 《$$ティターンズ$$》 and 《$$ブルーコスモス$$》
　held real power.」

stage0008_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I thought those groups were wiped out in
　the $$多元戦争$$, but their roots run
　deeper than I imagined.」

stage0008_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$さやか$$
「Is it going to be war, Federation vs Neo Zeon...?」

stage0008_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Tensions between them are rising, sure,
　but without some major trigger, I don't
　think it'll come to war.」

stage0008_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Besides, it's not like every Spacenoid
　supports $$ハマーン$$'s hardline stance
　anyway.」

stage0008_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Still, I hear some people are trying to
　set up a member of the Zabi family, the old
　Zeon leaders, as a figurehead.」

stage0008_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It might seem nonsensical, but an
　organization needs some kind of symbol
　to move people.」

stage0008_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$甲児$$
「In that sense, this $$ハマーン$$ person...
　she's kind of scary, not the type people
　rally around as a leader.」

stage0008_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, that's a relief.
　That Zabi is a girl named $$ミネバ$$ Zabi, right?」

stage0008_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Saw it on the news somewhere...
　apparently she's not even ten yet.」

stage0008_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$甲児$$
「Oh, right, haven't introduced you.
　This is $F.
　Also our classmate.」

stage0008_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$.
　I fought alongside $$甲児$$ in the Regeneration
　War, but now I'm a test pilot at Anaheim.」

stage0008_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$ファ・ユイリィ$$.
　At Anaheim I'm $$カミーユ$$'s assistant.」

stage0008_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$n
「Thanks for the help in the fight the other day.」

stage0008_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you're the pilot of that blue machine...」

stage0008_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Seems like the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will be moving
　with the Quarter for the time being.
　Nice to meet you properly.」

stage0008_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$カミーユ$$...
　What happened to the $$Ｚガンダム$$?」

stage0008_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Zeta's getting overhauled at Anaheim on
　the Moon. Checking every part takes quite a while.」

stage0008_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guys like the ones from before showed up...
　Hope it comes back soon.」

stage0008_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（But this maintenance on the Zeta was too sudden.
　Unnaturally so...）

stage0008_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So, $n...
　what did you mean, can't be optimistic?」

stage0008_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$n
「Some underground sites are saying the
　publicly known $$ミネバ$$ Zabi is a body double,
　and the real one is older.」

stage0008_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ファ$$
「Why use a younger stand-in at all?」

stage0008_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$n
「Probably to throw off the Federation's guard.」

stage0008_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I see.
　Make the Federation let its guard down by
　seeming like just a kid.」

stage0008_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Thinking about the unease I felt meeting
　$$ミネバ$$ Zabi in the $$多元戦争$$, that
　might not just be a rumor...）

stage0008_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（But what is this... this unease...
　Am I just intimidated by $$ハマーン$$'s pressure...?）

stage0008_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$リディ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, once your touching reunion settles
　down, mind introducing us too?」

stage0008_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$リディ$$
「I don't know the circumstances last time,
　but the Quarter's younger members
　vanished off somewhere right away.」

stage0008_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$リディ$$
「Well then, let me introduce myself to you
　kids. Ensign $$リディ・マーセナス$$, I fly
　$$リゼル$$ Unit 2 on this ship.」

stage0008_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$リディ$$
「That's a sore spot...
　$$カミーユ$$'s got Unit 1.」

stage0008_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$リディ$$
「It's a bit pathetic, trailing behind a
　civilian, but sadly $$カミーユ$$'s the better
　pilot right now.」

stage0008_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$リディ$$
「No, no, I'm formally throwing down
　a challenge to you.
　You'll accept, $$カミーユ$$?」

stage0008_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If that's what you want, Ensign.」

stage0008_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$リディ$$
「Good, it's settled.
　...You're all witnesses.
　I'll take the ace's spot from $$カミーユ$$ myself.」

stage0008_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「He's pretty easygoing for
　a soldier.」

stage0008_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$アルト$$
「They call them Federation elites, so I
　expected someone stiffer, but I think
　we'll get along fine with him.」

stage0008_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$エマ$$
「The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ is mostly an
　experimental deployment, so it might
　be a bit unusual.」

stage0008_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$エマ$$
「I'm Lieutenant $$エマ・シーン$$.
　I've heard about you all from $$カミーユ$$ and $$ファ$$.」

stage0008_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$カツ$$
「I'm $$カツ・コバヤシ$$.
　Same as $$カミーユ$$ and $$ファ$$, I'm a test
　pilot at Anaheim.」

stage0008_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ファ$$
「Lieutenant $$エマ$$ and $$カツ$$ fought alongside
　$$カミーユ$$ and me in $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$.」

stage0008_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アルト$$
「So, a member of that 《$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$》, huh.」

stage0008_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Sounds like we can count on them.」

stage0008_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$リディ$$
「Hey now, I was never part of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$,
　but you can count on me too.」

stage0008_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「By the way, Lieutenant $$エマ$$...
　what did you mean by experimental deployment?」

stage0008_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$エマ$$
「The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ is the successor to
　a ship called the Argama, which $$エゥーゴ$$
　originally used.」

stage0008_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アルト$$
「《$$エゥーゴ$$》...
　The group $$カミーユ$$ and the others belonged to.」

stage0008_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$エマ$$
「Because of the mess when $$エゥーゴ$$ got folded
　into the Federation, there's no sister ship.」

stage0008_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$エマ$$
「So naturally we get sent on solo missions,
　acting apart from the main Londo Bell force.」

stage0008_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So Ensign $$リディ$$ and I were running
　evaluation tests on the new $$リゼル$$, but...」

stage0008_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We chased what looked like a Neo Zeon unit
　that dropped into the atmosphere, and ended
　up in real combat.」

stage0008_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Is that $$リゼル$$ a mass-production version
　of the $$Ｚガンダム$$ you flew?」

stage0008_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It inherits the concept, but structurally
　it's more of an evolution of the $$メタス$$.」

stage0008_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ファ$$
「That's why I'm part of the testing too.」

stage0008_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$甲児$$
「So us meeting again like this was
　basically a coincidence, then.」

stage0008_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アルト$$
「When we get time, I'll show you around
　$$第２新東京市$$. $$沙慈$$'s at Anaheim Tech too.」

stage0008_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He's here in Japan too, huh.」

stage0008_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$リディ$$
「It's nice, isn't it...
　reuniting with old friends.」

stage0008_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$エマ$$
「Ensign... this might not be my place,
　but while you're on Earth, why not visit
　your family once?」

stage0008_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$リディ$$
「...Not until the day I can be proud I've
　made it on my own, with no help from my
　family name...」

stage0008_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$リディ$$
「That's exactly why I want to beat $$カミーユ$$.」

stage0008_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「All pilots, report to the Briefing Room.」

stage0008_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$カツ$$
「Did something happen, Major $$コンロイ$$?」

stage0008_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「The team tracking the terrorists from
　before reported finding what looks like
　a suspicious group's hideout.」

stage0008_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$エマ$$
「Are they linked to Neo Zeon?」

stage0008_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「We're moving to confirm that.
　Quarter members will help out too.」

stage0008_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「That's right.
　It's a sudden mission, and this ship doesn't
　carry many ground-combat personnel.」

stage0008_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Not just the $$ミスリル$$ members...
　we'll need you for backup too.」

stage0008_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$甲児$$
「Leave it to us.
　When it comes to investigating, we've got
　a pro on our side.」

stage0008_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0008_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「...So this boy is the
　professional investigator?」

stage0008_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$'s an $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ boy detective,
　so this kind of job's nothing new.」

stage0008_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I've heard the rumors about him too.
　I don't doubt his record, of course.」

stage0008_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But I have no intention of relying on a child.」

stage0008_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「This is a soldier's domain.
　I appreciate your willingness to help,
　but I can't allow you to come along.」

stage0008_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Is that acceptable, Major $$オズマ$$?」

stage0008_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Command of this operation belongs
　to the Echoes. We have no objection.」

stage0008_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$オズマ$$
「You heard him, everyone.
　...$$正太郎$$, $$ワッ太$$, $$さやか$$, Takeo General
　Company: stand by. Rest of you, move out.」

stage0008_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Breach on target is 1600 hours.
　Section leads will brief the details.」

stage0008_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's that supposed to mean!
　Forget me, but calling $$正太郎$$ useless!」

stage0008_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「...That concludes the briefing.
　I expect the best from all of you.」

stage0008_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「That stubborn old man!
　Just because we're kids, he's mocking us!」

stage0008_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Doesn't it bug you, $$正太郎$$!
　You've solved so many cases before!」

stage0008_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Saying it doesn't bug me would be a lie.」

stage0008_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$正太郎$$
「So I'm going to help with this
　operation in my own way.」

stage0008_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Will you help me, $$ワッ太$$?」

stage0008_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Of course!
　Let's make that old stubborn head eat his words!」

stage0008_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$クルツ$$
「This is bad, Lt. Colonel!
　We might've been set up!」

stage0008_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$宗介$$
「This tremor...!
　An attack from outside!」

stage0008_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Damn! What are you doing, $$コンロイ$$!?
　Why didn't you notice the enemy's approach!?」

stage0008_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「...I think today's battle wiped out
　most of what's left of the Robot Mafia.」

stage0008_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I hope this settles down the bad
　guys who've been targeting Tokyo.」

stage0008_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「What is it?
　Come to apologize for leaving $$正太郎$$ out!?」

stage0008_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Stop it, $$ワッ太$$.
　The Lt. Colonel had his reasons.」

stage0008_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Once we're grown up too, I'm sure we'll understand.」

stage0008_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「...You saw through it all, huh.
　You really are an $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ boy detective.」

stage0008_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But let me say this much.
　...I respect your professionalism.」

stage0008_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you.
　I respect your sense of responsibility
　toward your work too, Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$.」

stage0008_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Tch...!
　You two getting cozy, now I'm left out!」

stage0008_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「No... running a company as a grade
　schooler is impressive too, I think.」

stage0008_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「What, Mister $$ダグザ$$!
　You do understand after all!」

stage0008_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$エマ$$
「Looks like things went well over there.」

stage0008_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$リディ$$
「But we weren't able to grasp
　what Neo Zeon is actually aiming for.」

stage0008_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$エマ$$
「Just look at that Enhanced-Human-only
　unit, there's no way that squad from
　the other day is unrelated to Neo Zeon...」

stage0008_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$カツ$$
「Does $$ハマーン$$ intend to wage war on
　the Earth Federation? If so, I can't forgive it.」

stage0008_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$カツ$$
「After $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ finally joined
　hands to build the Earth Federation...!」

stage0008_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But the Federation isn't free of problems either.」

stage0008_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The deep-rooted contempt for Spacenoids,
　left unchecked, will breed a big war someday.」

stage0008_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$カツ$$
「So you're saying it can't be helped
　even if a war breaks out, $$カミーユ$$...!?」

stage0008_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's not what I meant.」

stage0008_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why the Federation's response
　to the suspected Neo Zeon force matters.」

stage0008_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ファ$$
「They won't use this as an excuse to
　suddenly crack down on Spacenoids...」

stage0008_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$エマ$$
「Doing that would only stir up more
　resentment, that's how wars start.」

stage0008_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$エマ$$
「Besides, the moderates within the
　Federation won't let a few hotheads run wild.」

stage0008_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Maybe Neo Zeon moved that force
　from the start just to see how
　the Federation would react...）

stage0008_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（But would $$ハマーン$$ really take
　such a cautious approach...?
　If so, then behind it there's...）

stage0008_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カツ$$
「I'll say it straight, $$カミーユ$$.
　Part of you keeps thinking about Captain $$クワトロ$$.」

stage0008_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$カツ$$
「What you fear most right now
　is that Captain $$クワトロ$$ became Neo
　Zeon's leader and ordered this fight.」

stage0008_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$リディ$$
「Wait a second.
　Wasn't Captain $$クワトロ$$ the leader
　of $$エゥーゴ$$? Why would he join Neo Zeon...」

stage0008_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That man is $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　also known as Zeon's Red Comet.」

stage0008_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$甲児$$
「Who is that?
　This '$$シャア・アズナブル$$' guy.」

stage0008_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$エマ$$
「It probably means nothing to you
　$$ＡＤＷ$$ folks, but he was a Zeon ace pilot.」

stage0008_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$エマ$$
「Not only was he a superb pilot,
　they say his charisma made him
　more than just an officer.」

stage0008_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$シャア$$ was $$アムロ$$'s rival, and they
　fought many times in the war between
　Zeon and the Federation, the $$一年戦争$$.」

stage0008_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$甲児$$
「But Captain $$クワトロ$$ fought the
　$$多元戦争$$ with $$エゥーゴ$$ alongside
　$$カミーユ$$ and Captain $$アムロ$$, didn't he?」

stage0008_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He thought about what mattered most
　to the world then, and fought alongside us.」

stage0008_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That didn't change even when we were
　thrown into $$ＡＤＷ$$ and fought as $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

stage0008_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So I don't want to believe that
　Captain $$クワトロ$$ went back to Neo
　Zeon and started this fight.」

stage0008_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$リディ$$
「No use dwelling on what hasn't happened.
　Just do your best with what's in front of you.」

stage0008_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$リディ$$
「Because that's how I want to live.」

stage0008_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$リディ$$
「If you're grateful, help compile the
　combat data. The unit leading that Geara
　Doga squad seems built for an Enhanced Human.」

stage0008_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yes.
　If I can help, I will.」

stage0008_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$甲児$$
「Do your best, $$カミーユ$$.
　We're heading back.」

stage0008_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Back to the Quarter, you mean?」

stage0008_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$アルト$$
「No, to $$第２新東京市$$.
　We need to prep for next week's school trip.」

stage0008_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$甲児$$
「In the end we skipped all of
　today's afternoon classes, so there's
　probably a lot of trouble waiting for us.」

stage0008_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Come to think of it, you're all students too.」

stage0008_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're not Federation military either,
　so why not come to Jindai High?」

stage0008_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「No... I chose to be a test pilot.
　Right now I want to focus fully on this.」

stage0008_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$甲児$$
「You and $n are both so serious.
　Don't push yourselves too hard.」

stage0008_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Captain $$クワトロ$$...
　You, who fought 《$$トレーズ$$》 Khushrenada...
　I believe you won't do anything foolish.）

stage0008_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（So I won't dwell on things I
　can't help, and go my own way.）

stage0008_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$n
「No... $$宗介$$'s the right one for this.」

stage0008_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$n
「I'm going to say it, $$宗介$$.
　Most of Chidori's stress is because of you.」

stage0008_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$n
「And we're the ones catching the fallout.」

stage0008_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$宗介$$
「I am merely carrying out my mission.」

stage0008_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Fine, then I'll carry out my own
　mission as class representative...」

stage0008_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You two!
　What were you doing skipping class yesterday!?」

stage0008_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$甲児$$
「Y-yesterday, that was, well... there
　were reasons...! Right, $$アルト$$?」

stage0008_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I've no interest in hearing lame excuses!」

stage0008_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I've decided!
　For next month's school trip duties...!」

stage0008_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You and your merry band of friends
　are all doing trash duty!」

stage0008_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$n
（Don't, $$アルト$$...
　You can't win an argument with her.）

stage0008_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This is the class rep's decision!」

stage0008_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$n
「So this is how it ends up...」

stage0008_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So... Jindai High goes to Okinawa
　for a school trip next week?」

stage0008_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Nice, isn't it.
　Youth in bloom beneath the southern sun...」

stage0008_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though I doubt the southern sun suits
　$n or $$宗介$$, if I'm being honest.」

stage0008_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let me follow $$ダグザ$$ and
　$$正太郎$$'s example and work like a
　true pro. So, today too, business, business!」
